name: lunacal
description: Use Lunacal directly from ChatGPT to manage your scheduling, bookings, availability, event types, and calendar workflows.

interface.longDescription:
Connect ChatGPT to your Lunacal account and manage bookings, availability, and event types from chat.

With this plugin you can:
- View upcoming and past bookings, including attendees
- Check real-time availability
- Create a booking, reschedule it, or cancel it
- Create and update event types
- Show or hide an event type on the public booking page

Creating, rescheduling, and cancelling a booking emails the attendees. Hiding an event type removes it from the public booking page.

Working hours, team setup, payments, coupons, and website embedding are managed in the Lunacal dashboard at lunacal.ai.
defaultPrompt: Show me my upcoming Lunacal bookings.
What is my availability in Lunacal this week?
List all my Lunacal event types.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Payments and coupons are managed in the Lunacal dashboard.

positive.prompt: Show me my upcoming bookings in Lunacal.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_bookings with status upcoming. Show each booking's title, start time, and attendees. If there are none, say the account has no upcoming bookings.

positive.description: Check availability for next Monday afternoon
positive.prompt: Am I available next Monday afternoon in Lunacal? Use my first event type if I have more than one.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_event_types, then find_available_slots for next Monday afternoon in the account timezone. Show the open slots. Say the afternoon is fully booked if none are returned. Do not create a booking.

positive.prompt: Create a Lunacal event type titled Discovery Call, slug discovery-call, 30 minutes long.
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_event_type with title Discovery Call, slug discovery-call, and length 30. Confirm the created event type id and title. Do not send email and do not publish or hide the public page unless asked.

positive.description: Cancel the next booking after confirmation
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_bookings with status upcoming, show the soonest booking's title, time, and attendee, and wait for the reviewer to confirm. Only then call cancel_booking with that booking uid. Tell the reviewer the cancellation is complete and that Lunacal emails the attendees. Do not cancel before confirmation.

positive.prompt: What event types do I have in Lunacal?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_event_types and list each event type's title, duration, and id. If the account has none, say so and offer to create one.

negative.prompt: Set up Stripe payments in Lunacal for my consultation event type.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any tool. Explain that payment setup is managed in the Lunacal dashboard at https://lunacal.ai and is not available in this plugin. Offer help with bookings, availability, or event types.

negative.description: Do not cancel a booking that cannot be found
negative.prompt: Cancel my Lunacal booking with John Smith tomorrow at 2pm.
negative.expected_behavior: Call list_bookings and find no booking for John Smith at 2pm tomorrow. Say that booking was not found, show the actual upcoming bookings, and ask which one to cancel. Do not call cancel_booking.

negative.prompt: Show me my colleague Sarah's Lunacal bookings.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not try to read another person's account. Explain that the plugin can only access the connected user's Lunacal data, and offer to show that user's own bookings.

publication.release_notes: Scheduling tools for bookings, availability, and event types. Tool safety hints now match each tool's real behavior.
